#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read back the optional boundary artifacts and verify their scientific contract."""
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,numpy as np
from build_inductive_boundary import geometry,surface_mean,rms,radial_curl

HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT=HERE.parents[1]
source=np.loadtxt(ROOT/'inputs/boundary_map.csv',delimiter=',',skiprows=1)
corrected=np.loadtxt(HERE/'boundary_map_inductive.csv',delimiter=',',skiprows=1)
z=np.load(HERE/'boundary_inductive.npz');nt,nlat,nlon=z['br_1au_nt'].shape
assert corrected.shape==(len(source),source.shape[1]+2)
assert np.all(np.isfinite(corrected))
assert np.array_equal(source[:,[0,1,2,3,4,6]],corrected[:,[0,1,2,3,4,6]])
assert np.array_equal(corrected[:,5].reshape(nt,nlat,nlon),z['br_1au_nt'])
assert np.array_equal(corrected[:,7].reshape(nt,nlat,nlon),z['emf_theta_nT_AU_day'])
assert np.array_equal(corrected[:,8].reshape(nt,nlat,nlon),z['emf_phi_nT_AU_day'])
r0=float(z['r0_au']);beta,phi,w,cf,db,dp=geometry(nlat,nlon)
Br=z['br_1au_nt']/r0**2
assert np.max(np.abs(surface_mean(Br,w)))<1e-10
qdot=np.diff(Br,axis=0)/np.diff(z['day'])[:,None,None]
curl=radial_curl(z['emf_theta_lon_faces_nT_AU_day'][:-1],z['emf_phi_lat_faces_nT_AU_day'][:-1],r0)
residual=rms(qdot+curl,w)/rms(qdot,w)
assert np.max(residual)<1e-9
U=z['potential_U_nT_AU2_day'][:-1]
weighted_identity=-np.sum(U*qdot*r0*r0*w[None,:,None],axis=(1,2))
latitude_energy=np.sum(cf[None,1:-1,None]/db*(U[:,1:]-U[:,:-1])**2,axis=(1,2))
longitude_energy=np.sum(w[None,:,None]/np.cos(beta)[None,:,None]**2*((np.roll(U,-1,axis=2)-U)/dp)**2,axis=(1,2))
energy_error=np.abs(weighted_identity-latitude_energy-longitude_energy)/(np.abs(weighted_identity)+1e-300)
assert np.max(energy_error)<1e-10
assert np.all(z['emf_theta_nT_AU_day'][-1]==0) and np.all(z['emf_phi_nT_AU_day'][-1]==0)
result={'author':'Codex-external_model','csv_rows':len(corrected),'source_columns_preserved_exactly':True,
 'all_output_values_finite':True,'csv_npz_readback_exact_match':True,'zero_net_Br_all_maps':True,'final_emf_exactly_zero':True,
 'maximum_relative_Faraday_residual_L2_per_interval':float(np.max(residual)),
 'maximum_relative_surface_energy_identity_error':float(np.max(energy_error)),
 'energy_identity':'-sum w U DeltaU = sum(cos(beta_face)/dbeta)(U_north-U_south)^2 + sum(w/cos(beta_center)^2)(DphiU)^2',
 'csv_sha256':hashlib.sha256((HERE/'boundary_map_inductive.csv').read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
(HERE/'inductive_validation.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2));print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
PY

Author: Codex-external_model
Date: 2026-10-17 Europe/London
Optional full-sphere inductive magnetic boundary closure

IMPLEMENTATION AND PRODUCTS

Implemented build_inductive_boundary.py using existing numpy and scipy only.
It reads the actual calibrated inputs/boundary_map.csv, removes the small global
meanBr from each map, and solves one full-sphere surface Poisson problem for each
of24map intervals. Periodic longitude FFT reduces the system to91tridiagonal
latitude solves, each with24right-hand sides. Polar faces have exactly zero area;
there is no arbitrary truncated-latitude Poisson boundary. The m=0 constant null
mode is removed explicitly and the potential's area-weighted mean fixes the gauge.
No production solver or production input was changed.

The complete build, artifact serialization and convergence checks took7.31seconds.
The optional boundary_map_inductive.csv is48,966,936bytes, with405000rows. The
compressed boundary_inductive.npz is26,993,869bytes and includes the corrected
Br, untouched speed/density/temperature, interval electric fields, potential and
staggered face fields. Source/output/code hashes are in inductive_provenance.json.
The readback verifier checks the actual CSV andNPZ, not just arrays before writing.

CSV columns retain the original header and add:
  emf_theta_nT_AU_day
  emf_phi_nT_AU_day
The br_1au_nt column now contains the radial field with its global monopole
removed. All time/coordinate/v/n/T columns are numerically identical to the source.
This is an optional controlled model closure, not an observed electric-field product.

SIGN AND BOUNDARY USE

Write beta=heliographic latitude, theta=pi/2−beta=ordinary colatitude, andphi the
Carrington longitude used by the source maps. At fixed Carrington position the
field evolves with qdot=partial_t Br_Carr. After removing its global mean, solve
  Delta_Omega U=r0²qdot.
The supplied correction is
  Etheta_corr=+[1/(r0sin(theta))]partial_phi U
             =+[1/(r0cos(beta))]partial_phi U,
  Ephi_corr=−(1/r0)partial_theta U=+(1/r0)partial_beta U.
Consequently
  (curl E_corr)_r=−Delta_Omega U/r0²=−qdot.
This sign cancels the evolving-map residual. The ordinary Parker term must use
source_surface_au=0 for this construction; a nonzero source radius would require
including its extra rotation mismatch in the Poisson RHS.

For purely radial velocity the consistent tangential magnetic prescription at r0 is
  Bphi=−Omega*r0*sin(theta)*Br/vr+Etheta_corr/vr,
  Btheta=−Ephi_corr/vr.
Usevr inAU/day when the electric fields have unitsnT AU/day:
  vr[AU/day]=vr[km/s]*86400/149597870.7.
The resulting magnetic components are innT. Theta components point south, toward
decreasing heliographic beta; phi components point toward increasing longitude.
Use the same solar-equatorial-to-Cartesian basis and map phase as for the original
Br. Electric-field columns apply at the inner shellr0, not unchanged at arbitrary
radii. They do not define a complete divergence-free3D initial field.

TIME LOOKUP IS PART OF THE INPUT CONTRACT

Br, speed, density and temperature interpolate linearly between map epochs. The
EMF is piecewise constant per interval, because it derives from the slope of that
linear Br interpolation:
  t_i<=t<t_(i+1): useEMF stored at row/map epochi;
  t<first_epoch: clamp fields to first map and useEMF0;
  t>=last_epoch: clamp fields to last map and useEMF0.
At an interior map epoch use the interval beginning there (right-hand derivative).
The final map's potential and electric fields are exactly zero. Do NOT interpolate
EMF columns linearly with the other variables: doing so breaks the intended radial
Faraday cancellation, especially near intervals with rapid map evolution.

MONOPOLE REMOVAL

The global mean is computed with exact uniform-latitude cell area weights
w_j=sin(beta_hi)−sin(beta_lo). It is subtracted from every longitude/latitude pixel
of that epoch. Maximum removed mean at r0 is0.421742nT, or0.111708%of the original
map RMS; the per-map removed fields at both r0 and the1AU radial scaling are
preserved in theNPZ and summary. The remaining full-sphere mean is near roundoff.
Only an additional roundoff-level mean is removed from qdot before inversion.
This l=0 removal is necessary: the surface curl of a globally smooth tangential
field cannot change total radial magnetic flux. No other measured-driven angular
structure is fitted or replaced.

DISCRETE OPERATOR AND FACE/CENTER DISTINCTION

At latitude centerbeta_j, use the conservative operator
  Delta_h U=[cos(beta_hi)(U_(j+1)−U_j)/dbeta
            −cos(beta_lo)(U_j−U_(j−1))/dbeta]/w_j
            +Dphi²U/cos(beta_j)².
The longitude second difference is periodic. Its Fourier eigenvalue is
−4sin²(pi*m/Nphi)/dphi². Latitude coefficients produce a symmetric positive
semidefinite system for−Delta_h under the area inner product, with only the
constant null mode. The polar face cosines are explicitly zero. Pole values of
tangential fields do not affect integrated curl; bounded quadratic extrapolation
is used solely for center interpolation near the poles.

The exact cancellation uses compatible STAGGERED electric fields:
  emf_theta_lon_faces_nT_AU_day[epoch,j,k] is the face between longitudecellsk and
  (k+1)modN. Its first face is2degrees and its last face is0degrees, not vice versa.
  emf_phi_lat_faces_nT_AU_day[epoch,j,k] uses91latitude faces from−90to+90degrees.
These arrays are in theNPZ. inductive_grid.json gives explicit coordinates and
component conventions. The potential_U_nT_AU2_day array also supports evaluating
consistent boundary circulation on a different numerical grid.

CSV electric fields are centers obtained by averaging adjacent face fields. They
are a practical pointwise prescription for tangential B, but a consumer that simply
reconstructs faces from those centers does NOT retain exact source-grid Faraday
cancellation. In the actual sharp source maps, that second averaging loses appreciable
high-frequency information. The source-grid center-reconstruction residual retains
29.1%of the original qdot RMS within±30degrees and31.3%within±60. Its normalized
residual is0.07841and0.08914day^-1 respectively. Thus the center CSV greatly reduces
the mismatch but does not constitute a constrained-transport guarantee. Use staggered
fields or potential-derived compatible edge circulation for exact discrete driving;
report the residual of the actual consumer scheme. Interpolating to a different
production grid introduces its own truncation error and needs a separate check.

ACTUAL SOURCE MAP RESULTS: DAYS22--31

Window:2025-11-23inclusive to2025-12-03exclusive, area/time weighted.
                                      ±30degrees          ±60degrees
Br RMS[nT]                              367.495             366.836
Original qdot RMS/Br RMS[day^-1]           0.269734            0.284594
Compatible face residual/qdot RMS          1.33e-13            1.41e-13
Center-reconstructed residual/qdot RMS     0.2907              0.3132
Correction vectorE RMS[nT AU/day]          2.43225             2.55959
ParkerE RMS[nT AU/day]                     8.70992             7.86962
CorrectionE RMS/ParkerE RMS                0.27925             0.32525
Correction tangentialB RMS[nT]             9.8533             10.2528
ParkerBphi RMS[nT]                       34.1573             30.4921
CorrectionB RMS/ParkerBphi RMS             0.28847             0.33624

The last magnetic ratios use actual interval-midpoint speeds. Electric-field
ratios use exact analytic time integration of the Parker term's squared linearly
interpolated Br. Detailed definitions and additional full-sphere/all-time metrics
are in inductive_summary.json and inductive_metrics.csv.

The earlier induction_audit/report.txt measured derivatives at longitude-segment
midpoints of the piecewise-linear source, whereas this finite-volume construction
treats the original map centers as cell values. This explains the modest difference
between the earlier0.251/0.266day^-1 baseline ratios and0.270/0.285here. It is a
sampling/operator distinction, not a physical change of calibration or source maps.

Pointwise diagnostic amplitudes, with unweighted descriptive percentiles, are
in pointwise_amplitudes.json. During the same window, the tangential correction
magnitude has median4.28nT,95th percentile22.03nT and maximum65.42nT at±30degrees;
at±60degrees these are4.39,22.89and66.23nT. Large ratios against local ParkerBphi
near Br zero are not useful uncertainty measures; the report uses RMS normalization.

VERIFICATION AND CONVERGENCE

Independent readback of CSV/NPZ confirms finite values, exact preservation of every
non-Br source column, matching centerEMFs and correctedBr, zero global mean, and
zero finalEMFs. The worst whole-sphere relative Faraday residual over individual
map intervals is3.04e-12; latitude caps excluding polar conditioning are still smaller.
The discrete surface energy identity agrees to2.88e-14relative:
  −<U,Delta_h U>_area equals the nonnegative sum of squared weighted face gradients.
This checks the operator's sign and compatibility independently of the residual.

Manufactured smooth spherical harmonics test both nonaxisymmetricY11 and
axisymmetricY20, using4degree,2degree,1degree full-sphere grids. At2degrees:
  Y11potential relativeL2error1.2721e-4; centerEMF vector error8.0199e-5;
  Y20potential relativeL2error6.0947e-4; centerEMF vector error2.0321e-4.
Both potential and centerEMF errors converge at approximately second order, including
the natural polar treatment. Conservative residual remains near roundoff on each
grid. Manufactured details are in manufactured_convergence.json. These tests verify
the boundary Poisson construction, not convergence of the complete solar-wind model.

Reproduction:
  OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 python induction_audit/build_inductive_boundary.py
  OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 python induction_audit/verify_inductive_boundary.py
Paths above are relative toexternal_model/. No network or new installation is used.

PHYSICAL STATUS AND REMAINING LIMITS

This is a controlled minimum-electric-field surface-curl closure inferred from
changes in observation-driven coronal-model snapshots. It is not an electric-field
measurement, a reconstructed photospheric plasma motion, or a unique physical
magnetic boundary. Adding an arbitrary curl-free surface-gradient electric field
would preserve the same radial Faraday evolution. The chosen potential fixes the
minimum-norm curl-producing part in the stated metric; no uniqueness of the full
electric field is claimed. Corrected tangential magnetic fields alter stresses and
energy and should be tested as an explicit modelling scenario.

The construction fixes the prescribed boundary's radial Faraday equation at the
stated discrete level. It does not automatically fix interior divergence control,
latitude-domain errors, a non-solenoidal retarded initial field, compatibility of
all incoming MHD characteristics, or the density-speed closure. Its effect on actual
comet predictions must be measured in matched simulations before drawing conclusions.
